import numpy as np
import json

r1 = np.load("/work/fwd/r1/run.npz")
r7 = np.load("/work/fwd/r7/run.npz")

# Evidence summary:
# L0_MLP COMBINER: same token at different positions → different writes (diff up to 1.89)
mlp = r1["L0_MLP"]
diff_oclrzaw = max(np.max(np.abs(mlp[0,1]-mlp[0,4])), np.max(np.abs(mlp[0,1]-mlp[0,9])))
diff_tpsi = np.max(np.abs(mlp[1,2]-mlp[1,4]))
print(f"L0_MLP position-dependence: oCLrZaW={diff_oclrzaw:.3f}, TPSI={diff_tpsi:.3f}")

print(f"Baseline seq0: {list(np.argmax(r1['logits'][0],axis=-1))}")

# L1H0_ATTN ROUTER: concentrated attention (~100% on one position)
pat = r1["L1H0_ATTN_pattern"]
max_vals = [np.max(pat[s,pos,:pos+1]) for s in range(4) for pos in range(1,10)]
